articles.title: TSG Hails Flamingos’ Historic World Cup Victory, Commends Tinubu

The group described the victory as a landmark achievement for Nigerian football and a defining moment for African women’s football, noting that the […]

articles.title: EFCC Declines Further Comments On Billions Recovered From RCCG

The Commission’s spokesperson, Dele Oyewale, declined to make further comments when contacted by LEADERSHIP, leaving unan

critical_questions: Why is the EFCC refusing to clarify details on recovered funds, and what does this opacity suggest about the investigation's legitimacy or complications?

articles.title: Troops Arrest Suspected Gunrunner, Kill Two Terrorists In Plateau

articles.hausa_translation: Sojan sun kama wani mai kasuwar makamai, sun kashe masu cin rani biyu a Plateau. Jami'ar sojoji ta bayyana cewa nasarar aiki ta karuwa shawo kanta na rushe hanyoyi da suke damje rashin aminci, a kawar da mahimmali kowa ligoni, da bada mahaimakon jiya a gida.

articles.title: Offa Bank Robbery: Drop Of Charges Is Admission Of False Claims, Saraki Drags Kwara Govt

articles.title: CHOGM 2026: Bianca seeks stronger commonwealth cooperation
articles.summary: Nigeria has called for stronger cooperation among Commonwealth member states to address security challenges, expand trade, strengthen democratic institutions and promote climate resilience. The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu, disclosed this on Monday in a post on her X account, detailing Nigeria’s expectations from the Commonwealth following her interventions a
articles.hausa_translation: CHOGM 2026: Bianca yana neman karfin haɗin gida na Commonwealth. Nijeriya ta kira ga karfin haɗin kai tsakanin ƙasashen Commonwealth don magance ƙalubale na aminci, fadada kasuwanci, ƙarfafawa cibiyoyin dimokrasi da haɓaka jiya ga yanayi. Ministan Jihar Harkokin Waje, Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu, ya bayyana hakan jiya asabar ne ta wajen sanarwa a kan asusuwan X, wanda ke fitar da tunanin Nijeriya daga ƙungiyar Commonwealth.

Who are the missing voices—smaller Commonwealth nations, civil society, or opposition viewpoints—that might challenge Nigeria's framing of these cooperation priorities?

articles.title: NYSC deployment surge caused Sagamu camp overcrowding — Ogun
